snippet.title: The Kingsward Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The Kingsward Announcement Trailer

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4421670/The_Kingsward/

Explore an open-world RPG with action combat, dynamic classes, and extensive crafting. With a massive world to discover and secrets around every corner, immerse yourself in a satirical and dramatic story where you must prove to your mother that you're not a failure by saving humanity from the stupidity of the king. (Any resemblance to real life is purely coincidental)
